text.p: Typhoon Carlo is near the northern Mariana Islands at this time, moving west northwest at 10 mph. Top winds are 75 mph. Carlo will cause squally conditions near the islands during the next 12 hours before it moves away from the region and conditions improve. Carlo will be a threat to shipping as well.

Hurricane Lili, with 75 mph winds, is 640 miles east of Bermuda and nearly stationary. This system is expected to weaken and lose tropical characteristics this period while drifting eastward, and is only a threat to shipping.

Tropical Cyclone 05A is nearly stationary in the Arabian Sea near 14.4n/69.3e, and is expected to drift northwestward during the next couple days. Top winds are near 45 mph and may strengthen slightly, making this system a threat to shipping.
